# Default time allocation

Starting points by target. Adjust by profile and journal weak spots.

| Target | DSA | Core subjects (OS/DBMS/CN/OOP/SQL) | System design | Projects & resume | Aptitude | HR / behavioral | Mocks |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Service-based companies (mass recruiters) | 25% | 20% | 0% | 10% | 25% | 10% | 10% |
| Product-based companies | 50% | 15% | 5% (LLD) | 10% | 0–5% | 5% | 15% |
| Big tech | 55% | 10% | 5–10% (LLD/basic HLD) | 5% | 0% | 5% | 15% |
| Startups | 30% | 10% | 10% | 30% (projects matter most) | 0% | 5% | 15% |
| Experienced (1–3 yrs) switch | 40% | 5% | 25% (HLD + LLD) | 5% | 0% | 10% | 15% |

Problem-count guidance (realistic, quality over quantity):
- Service-based: 80–120 easy/medium problems.
- Product-based: 200–300, mostly medium, covering every pattern in the catalog.
- Big tech: 300+, with 25–30% hard, strong on graphs and DP.

Revising old problems (spaced repetition: day 1, day 3, day 7, day 21) counts as DSA time and is non-negotiable.
